mapper.sql: option.id, option.retreat_id, option.schedule_item_id, option.option_type, option.label, option.event_date, option.display_order, option.is_active, option.created_at, option.updated_at, COUNT(registration_option.registration_id) FILTER (WHERE registration.status = 'REGISTERED') AS selection_count
mapper.select: SELECT FROM retreat_participation_options option LEFT JOIN registration_participation_options registration_option ON registration_option.option_id = option.id LEFT JOIN registrations registration ON registration.id = registration_option.registration_id WHERE option.retreat_id = (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN')) GROUP BY option.id ORDER BY option.event_date, option.display_order, option.id

SELECT FROM retreat_participation_options option LEFT JOIN registration_participation_options registration_option ON registration_option.option_id = option.id LEFT JOIN registrations registration ON registration.id = registration_option.registration_id WHERE option.schedule_item_id = #{scheduleItemId} AND option.retreat_id = (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN')) GROUP BY option.id

SELECT FROM retreat_participation_options option LEFT JOIN registration_participation_options registration_option ON FALSE LEFT JOIN registrations registration ON FALSE WHERE option.retreat_id = (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status = 'OPEN') AND option.is_active = TRUE GROUP BY option.id ORDER BY option.event_date, option.display_order, option.id

SELECT FROM retreat_participation_options option LEFT JOIN registration_participation_options registration_option ON registration_option.option_id = option.id LEFT JOIN registrations registration ON registration.id = registration_option.registration_id WHERE option.id = #{id} AND option.retreat_id = (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN')) GROUP BY option.id
SELECT id FROM retreat_participation_options WHERE retreat_id = (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN')) AND event_date = #{eventDate} AND lower(label) = lower(#{label})
mapper.update: UPDATE retreat_participation_options SET option_type = #{optionType}, label = #{label}, event_date = #{eventDate}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, is_active = #{active}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND retreat_id = (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN'))

UPDATE retreat_participation_options SET event_date = event_date + CAST(#{dayShift} AS INTEGER), is_active = is_active AND event_date + CAST(#{dayShift} AS INTEGER) BETWEEN #{startsOn} AND #{endsOn}, updated_at = now() WHERE retreat_id = #{retreatId} AND schedule_item_id IS NULL
UPDATE retreat_participation_options SET is_active = #{active}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND retreat_id = (SELECT id FROM retreats WHERE status IN ('DRAFT', 'OPEN'))
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM retreat_participation_options WHERE retreat_id = #{retreatId} AND is_active = TRUE ORDER BY event_date, display_order, id

SELECT selection.option_id FROM registration_participation_options selection JOIN retreat_participation_options option ON option.id = selection.option_id WHERE selection.registration_id = #{registrationId} ORDER BY option.event_date, option.display_order, option.id
